title: Discover context indices before loading large payloads
narrative: Fangore's host memory source must advertise what it can supply before dumping large payloads into a turn. Accepts inspiration requirement 6[^insp-r06].
implementation: `ContextProvider` / `StaticContextProvider` expose `index` then `load` with provenance and token estimates.
validation: Kind `context_provider_discovery`. Soft expects index before load and provider attribution.
